run_build_all_stats: run the script to build genre and speaker statistics on LibriBig data
run_gather_metadata: run the script to gather all JSON metadata files from the data directory
run_genre_statistics: run the script to build genre statistics and plot a pie chart of categories
run_speaker_statistics: run the script to build speaker statistics and plot a histogram of hours per speaker
run_with_ignore_cache: run the script with --ignore_cache to bypass cached results and recompute all statistics
